tools.description: Airport lounges at an airport, grouped by terminal, from cwsi.net's Lounge Finder: name, brand, concourse or gate, hours and access rules. Includes independent lounges (Escape, The Club, Plaza Premium and more) and which lounges take Priority Pass. Give a 3-letter IATA code such as ATL. Covers about 126 airports in the US, Canada, Mexico, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Oceania and Latin America.

airport.description: A 3-letter IATA airport code such as ATL (case-insensitive).

tools.name: calculate_flight_distance
tools.description: Great-circle distance in miles, nautical miles and kilometres for a route, leg by leg and in total, from cwsi.net's Great Circle Distance Calculator. Give airport codes joined by "-", e.g. ATL-SFO-ATL, with "~" between separate trips, e.g. ATL-SFO~SJC-ATL.

route.description: Airport codes joined by "-" (spaces or commas also work), e.g. "ATL-SFO-ATL". Use "~" between separate trips, e.g. "ATL-SFO~SJC-ATL". Codes are 3 or 4 letters or digits; each trip needs 2 or more; at most 5 trips and 20 codes.
